content: Hey all, since physics is now becoming more involved -- thoughts on Simons Problems?
I assume no interest but just in case i'll tag @Mario Krenn as he may have some opinions,

I think @Moritz Firsching or @Paul Lezeau are the right people to ask as the maintainers of the project. From my physics angle, these are interesting mathematical questions of one of the main construction of quantum physics - the Schrödinger operator. Simons is a well-regarded physicist, and such a list might is interesting.

Thanks for the ping - I think these would be nice to have! Some don’t really seems formalisable (e.g 11 and 12) but I’d say those that do are in scope as they are mathematical questions at the end of the day
